intro h
split
· intro s a ha
  have : s ⊆ insert a s := subset_insert a s
  exact h s (insert a s) ha
· intros s t hst
  induction hst with x xs using Finset.induction_on
  · exact le_refl (f s)
  · have : s ⊆ insert x s := subset_insert x s
    have : insert x s = s ∪ {x} := by rfl
    have : s ∪ {x} = insert x s := by rfl
    have : t = insert x (s ∪ {x}) := by rfl
    rw [this]
    exact h s x (not_mem_insert x s)
